instagram.caption: Meet Juniper & Lotus Cove! Our NEW collection is launching November 11th at 10 AM CT! Which tile and mat pairings do you want to see with these new arrivals?
Meet our NEW Confetti Racks! Four colors: purple, pink, blue and green. Shop Confetti Racks now! Short Pre-Order, expected delivery mid November.
Middle & Main Mahjong's flagship boutique is open! Grand opening weekend: raffle for Wanderlust or Odyssey Travel Tile Set (both available now), gift with purchase, 10% of sales to Fix-It.
Dear Santa Tiles + Christmas Solo Mat. Christmas Solo Mats are IN STOCK & READY TO SHIP!
FLASH SALE! 40K followers = 40% OFF OG Holiday Mahjong Mats: Perfectly Wrapped, Candy Cane Lane, Sugarplum Plaid. $70 -> $42 with code 40KMAT. Ends SATURDAY 6 AM CST.
Meet our mahjong bags in Emerald Green and Pearl White, clear front, printed lining. Available November 7 at 5 PM PST.
Art Deco Tile Collection paired with pink; sneak peek of a NEW mat coming soon to Bam! Let's Mahjong.
Mats: Chinoiserie Blue & Green (restock en route), Greenly (in stock), Shady Lady Umbrella Mat in Sunset Cabana Stripe (in stock).
Interviews with inspiring women coming soon.
Bombshell Pink. Butter Yellow. Pistachio. Peony. Chartreuse. New acrylic racks dropping 11/10 at 10 am CT.
Highlighting signature designs from our MCM collection: Available tomorrow, 11/6 at 10AM CT. Jokers (monkeys), winds, 1 Bam partridge, flowers, dragons.
Our doors officially open tomorrow! Friday, November 6th! Grand opening weekend.
Introducing HOLIDAY RACK PETS! Bag of 10 festive rack pets for $15. Shop now.
Bespoke is growing: closing the Dallas House of Mahjong playhouse for warehouse space; tiles, tables, accessories and new collections continue.
Back in Stock: White Embroidered BAM! Let's Mahjong Tile Bag.
Feel a chill in the air? A new season is coming to Amahj soon! Stay tuned!
Mat: Rochelle Didn't Make it to Midnight. Shop the full FALALADIES Winter Collection (nolijune.com/collections/falaladies). Comment LADIES for link + 10% off.
Packed with love, worth the wait. Behind the scenes as we get your Moving Sale finds out the door! Allow 7-10 business days to ship.
The countdown is on... MCM Olive returns this Friday! Restocking this Friday 11/6 at 10AM CT. Favorite mat recommendations for the MCM Olive tiles.
Meet the newest addition: Mega Swirled Dice! Pink, orange, green, blue & silver. Grab yours now!
Thanksgiving table: Autumn Bloom, Pumpkin Plaid & Heirloom Harvest mats. In stock & ready to ship!
Playing for Keeps goes live this Friday 11/6 and for subscribers 11/5. Pre-order with January delivery.
Completely sold out of the travel-size Lila mats! Now available for pre-order for early/mid January shipping. Full-size Lila available in about a month; pre-orders open once timing is known.
House Line No. 1 opens for public preorder at 12:30 PM CT today. Classic American Mahjong with jewel-toned details. Preorders ship February 2027.
FALALADIES is LIVE! Twelve new pieces (winter/holiday/Hanukkah/New Year's mats). Comment LADIES for link + 10% off.
Introducing the 2027 International Mahjong Card! Year of the Fire Goat, new beginner section. Now available for preorder! Expected to ship around the first of the year.
MCM Olive is making its return! Restocking this Friday, 11/6 at 10AM CT! Olive backs and a pink middle layer.
Middle & Main Gift Cards are now available online & in person (e-gift card on website).
SUNSHINE GLOW DROPS TOMORROW AT 9am CT!
NEW DROP: Meet SUNSHINE GLOW, Garden Glow tiles in sunshine-yellow pearl colorway. Dropping 11/4 at 9 AM CT.
Collector's List: House Line No. 1 preorder window opens 12:30 PM CT (private link by email). Ships February 2027.
Fall recap: French Mural arrival, house Domino print in mahjong, today's Oyster tile drop (Nov 3). In stock and ready to ship holiday.
The 2027 International Mahjong Card is officially available for preorder! Cards expected to ship around the first of the year.

Lattice talk about your next travel set. Miss Classic travel set: same faces as Miss Classic Malachite, bamboo lattice back, acrylic, racks, bag, Garden Party or Cherry Blossom travel mat, 4 Mahjong Press cards. Takes off Nov. 3rd at 10 am CT. Ready to ship.
OTG|247 x Charleston Mahjong Club collab available today: No. 8 Nudie Green tile bag, No. 5 Collab Clutch; coordinates with the Country Club Collection.
Sneak peek of new sets on the way: Wild, Sweet, Golf, Refined, Merry, Stir Things Up. Coming soon.
CABANA CLUB TRAVEL BUNDLES ARE OFFICIALLY OPEN FOR PRE-ORDER! Arrive in a few weeks, very short pre-order window.
House Line No. 1: collector access begins this week. Preorders ship February 2027.
FALALADIES is LIVE! Twelve new pieces for festive tables.
Our Hunt Club tiles are BACK IN STOCK, just in time for Halloween!
The Lila travel mat releases Monday, November 2nd at 10am EST. Only 100 mats available.
Halloween flash sale: 15% off $50+ with code SPOOKY.
Available now! Very small initial shipment of our Crown Jewels mahjong tiles.
Confetti tiles restock 11/11.
Meet the Poppy Red Racks, the newest pop of color! Pair with our holiday mats. Shop yours now.
Debut Whispering Winds tiles still in production; Joker story (Robin Hood cap).
Big announcement: in-person store coming soon, with mahjong tiles in stock when we open.
